# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first browser bubble shooter as `Squid Mask Memory Stage`: a Super-Mario-inspired theatrical reef where a squid-mask contestant launches emotional mask pearls upward into a hex grid. Preserve the exact loop of drag-to-aim, release-to-shoot, wall bounce, snap-to-grid, match 3+ clearing, floating-cluster drops, score updates, empty-board reset, danger-row failure, restart, and mute. Rebuild presentation with procedural canvas/CSS art: coral brick floor, pipe-like props, stars, curtains, expressive mask pearls, and a central squid-mask launcher. Use clear HUD copy (`Heart Score`, act names, match 3 instruction) and compact catalog-backed audio/GIF feedback. Keep controls readable and tappable in portrait mobile.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile-friendly canvas bubble shooter / cluster matcher
- objective: aim and launch one projectile at a hex bubble grid, clear clusters of three or more, drop disconnected clusters, and avoid letting landed bubbles reach the bottom danger rows
- input model: drag or touch to aim from the bottom launcher, release to shoot; buttons use normal click/tap; mute button does not shoot
- core loop: start game, build a 5-row hex grid, spawn one projectile, aim/release, bounce from walls, snap to ceiling or collision, resolve match/drop/scoring, spawn next projectile, repeat until loss or empty-grid reset
- fail/friction state: non-matching landings add pressure; landing at row `GRID_ROWS - 2` triggers game over and restart screen

## Protected Mechanics
- Drag/release aiming with upward angle clamp.
- Projectile speed relative to tile size, wall bounce, ceiling snap, and bubble contact snap.
- Hex-grid row parity, neighbor BFS, match threshold of 3, floating-cluster drop rule.
- Score semantics: matches score 10 each; dropped floating bubbles score 20 each.
- Empty-grid reset loop, game-over bottom-row threshold, start/restart/mute flows.

## Remix Blueprint
A squid-mask contestant performs on a Super-Mario-inspired reef stage. The bubbles are emotional mask pearls, the launcher is the contestant, matches restore memories, drops release hidden tears, and failure is the mask cracking under the curtain. Presentation changes are procedural canvas/CSS and catalog-backed media; mechanics remain the same bubble-shooter loop.
